newsitem.title: USA: Hilton breaks ground on Las Vegas property.
newsitem.headline: Hilton breaks ground on Las Vegas property.

text.p: Hilton Hotels Corp on Friday officially broke ground on its new $750 million hotel and casino in Las Vegas themed after the city of Paris.

Construction of the 3,000-room hotel and its 85,000 square foot casino is scheduled for completion in early 1999, Hilton said in a statement. It will be located on the Las Vegas "Strip" next to Bally's Las Vegas hotel/casino which is about 80-percent owned by Hilton.
Along with a 50-story, scale replica of the Eiffel Tower, the resort will feature replications of the Arc de Triomphe, the Paris Opera House, The Louvre and Rue de la Paix.
